description: Crossplane observability — organised by the roadmap capability areas (docs/roadmap.md). Rows labelled (Phase 2) stay empty until the 2.2/2.3 upgrade; the Cloud row is Upjet-providers only.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Crossplane Prometheus alerts currently firing (ALERTS{rulesgroup=crossplane}). Grafana-managed composite alerts show in Grafana Alerting, not here.

panels.title: Crossplane alert rules (all states)
panels.description: All Crossplane alert rules + states in one place — Grafana-managed (composite) AND Prometheus/UWM — filtered by rulesgroup=crossplane. NOTE: the Prometheus/Thanos alerts appear here only if that datasource has 'Manage alerts via Alerting UI' enabled in Grafana. The 'Alerts firing' stat (left) reads the ALERTS metric directly and always works — if it shows a count but this list is empty, datasource alerting isn't enabled.

panels.title: Claim tree p95 time-to-ready
panels.description: p95 time from creation to Ready for the full Claim → XR → MR tree (the headline provisioning-speed SLO).

panels.title: Not-ready / not-synced managed resources (count by GVK)
Time-to-readiness p50 / p95 / p99 by kind
Reconcile rate & error ratio — top N
Reconcile latency p50 / p95 / p99 — top N
Detection lag p95 — create→first reconcile — top N
Composite (XR) ready ratio by kind
panels.description: Per-XR-kind ready ratio from the inventory exporter, queried raw (not via the recording rule) so it works under OpenShift UWM where the recording rule is namespace-enforced to empty.

targets.expr: sum by (crossplane_kind) ({__name__=~"kube_customresource_crossplane_xr_.+_condition", type="Ready", status="True"}) / clamp_min(count by (crossplane_kind) ({__name__=~"kube_customresource_crossplane_xr_.+_condition", type="Ready", status="True"}), 1)

panels.title: Total managed resources
panels.description: Live count of all managed resources (sum of crossplane_managed_resource_exists).

panels.title: Billable units (XR/Claim)
panels.description: Count of customer-facing XR/Claim units (billing.unitMetricPattern), filtered by the $billable kind. Raw cross-namespace query (works under UWM).

panels.title: Distinct kinds in use
panels.description: Number of managed-resource kinds that currently have at least one resource.

panels.title: Composites (XRs)
panels.description: Total composite resources (needs the inventory exporter).

panels.title: Tenants
panels.description: Namespaces that own composites (needs the inventory exporter).

panels.title: Managed resources by kind (MRU basis)
panels.description: Live MR count per kind, the basis for per-kind MRU billing.

panels.title: Managed resources over time (growth)
panels.description: Fleet growth trend — capacity planning + billing trend.

panels.title: Billable units by kind
panels.description: Per-kind billable unit count. NOTE: counts XRs and Claims — narrow $billable and avoid counting both a Claim and the XR it creates.

panels.title: Billable claims by tenant
panels.description: Per-tenant chargeback from Claims (namespace = tenant workspace).

targets.expr: count by (namespace) ({__name__=~"kube_customresource_crossplane_claim_.+_condition", type="Ready", status="True", crossplane_kind=~"$billable", namespace=~"$tenant"})

panels.title: Billable claims by tenant & kind
panels.description: Per-tenant, per-kind claim counts — the chargeback breakdown.

targets.expr: count by (namespace, crossplane_kind) ({__name__=~"kube_customresource_crossplane_claim_.+_condition", type="Ready", status="True", crossplane_kind=~"$billable", namespace=~"$tenant"})
